issues.description: ContactPortal's composition occupied only ~49% of its 480-wide viewBox (art x 122-358, y 76-420); rendered at w-36 the doorway was ~71px wide with a ~37px phantom left margin, floating right of the flush-left label/h1 and shrinking the acid threshold to a ~1px sliver — the signature 'open door' moment read as a timid stamp.
issues.resolution: Redrew the portal to fill the viewBox (alfiz frame x 40-440 / y 44-440, acid threshold at y 456; art now ~84% of viewBox width) by proportionally rescaling every element — ogee arch, inner reveal, impost bands, spandrel roundels, threshold — with stroke weights rescaled 1.5/3.5 to 2/5, preserving the two-weight ratio and the reviewed design language. The frame became the leftmost mark, but a residual ~14px optical left inset remained at w-44 (frame at x=40, stroke edge ~x=39) — removed in round 2 by shifting the drawing flush-left in the viewBox. Placement in contact.astro sized up from w-36 to w-44, so the portal renders ~147px wide with a ~2px, 118px-wide acid threshold.

issues.description: 8-point-star bullets on the contact-details list rendered at w-2 h-2 (8px); the 16-vertex geometry collapsed into a fuzzy dot next to crisp text.
issues.resolution: Bumped all five bullet svgs to w-3 h-3 (12px) so the star geometry resolves, and re-indented the value rows pl-4 to pl-5 so values align with label text after star (12px) + gap-2 (8px) = 20px.

issues.description: The portal's leftmost mark (alfiz frame at x=40, stroke edge ~x=39) still renders with a ~14px phantom left inset at w-44 (39/480 x 176px), so the emblem's drawn edge sits visibly right of the flush-left 'Contact' label and the 48px serif h1 below it. The manifest's round-1 resolution claims the drawn edge is 'optically flush with the text stack' — it is much improved from the ~37px of round 1, but not flush; the 14px step is perceptible on the page's signature art moment.
issues.resolution: Translated the entire drawing 36 viewBox units left inside ContactPortal.astro (alfiz frame now x 4-404, leftmost stroke edge at x=3; symmetry axis moves 240 -> 204; spare viewBox units now sit on the right). Pure translation: every element's geometry, mirror symmetry, the 2/5 stroke pair, the 8-element count, and the single acid threshold are unchanged, so the reviewed design language is untouched. At w-44 (176px) the drawn left edge now sits ~1px inside the svg box — optically flush with the flush-left 'Contact' label and h1 — with no call-site negative-margin compensation (contact.astro placement unchanged at w-44 h-auto text-ink mb-10). Component header comment and the round-1 manifest wording updated to state the true coordinates.
